ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/off-white) pixels comprise approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels forming a continuous 10-15% border and isolated internal focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; continuous black band along the trailing edge; isolated black focal spots located at upper-left periphery, mid-left center, mid-right center, and lower-right base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 70 degrees; bounding-box depth extends roughly 15% into the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude recessions than the left; pixel-height variance between peaks and valleys ranges from 4 to 25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is a convex curve from the median notch to the lateral tips, with a subtle concave transition near the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters visible on the upper-left lobe near the edge and mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of 4-5 parallel, diagonal linear abrasions with brownish/orange pixel pigmentation located on the right lobe, oriented from top-right to bottom-left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular recession and jagged tissue loss on the far right distal tip; orange-pigmented linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Three thin, vertical dark lines (1-2 pixels wide) intersect the fluke's visual plane, crossing the left lobe, the median notch area, and the right lobe.
